Name: Recatch Legendary Fish
Author: cantorsdust
Description:
This mod lets you catch legendary fish as many times as you want. (You'll still get fishing achievements.)

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]You can optionally [url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/tree/master/RecatchLegendaryFish#configure]configure the mod[/url]﻿.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen. (In multiplayer, it only affects players who have it installed.)
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/blob/master/RecatchLegendaryFish/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
